source_refs.quote: The appellant took on lease, the first floor of the premises in question from the respondent
The respondent who was the owner of the entire premises was then occupying the ground floor.
The landlord filed an application, before the Rent Controller
The tenant opposed the claim of the landlord on both the grounds.
It is the view of both the Tribunals
held, in his report dated May 4, 1970
the premises in the occupation of the respondent were not reasonably suitable for his residence.
